Jha and Anastasia Kiyonaga; Journal of Experimental Psychology: Learning, Memory, and Cognition, 2010, 36(4), 1036–1042; DOI 10.1037/a0019337. Supplied canonical text is a full primary journal report with Methods, Results, Discussion and references, not an abstract or secondary report. No PDF was supplied; no rendering performed. At supplied original locator p.4 (printed p.1039), candidates include current distractor interference accuracy (F(1,53)=37.96, partial eta-squared .42, p < .001), current distractor interference RT (F(1,53)=40.40, partial eta-squared .43, p < .001), previous mnemonic load accuracy (F(1,53)=17.98, partial eta-squared .25, p < .001), previous mnemonic load RT (F(1,53)=5.93, partial eta-squared .10, p < .02), previous distractor interference accuracy (F(1,53)=9.20, partial eta-squared .15, p < .01), and current mnemonic load by previous distractor interference accuracy interaction (F(1,53)=5.69, partial eta-squared .10, p < .05). Other p-only tests on this page include previous distractor interference RT p > .10, previous load by previous interference accuracy p > .20 and RT p > .12, and current by previous mnemonic load accuracy interaction p > .32. A current mnemonic load RT p < .001 continues from p.3. Further interactions on p.5 (printed p.1040) are current interference by previous load (F(1,53)=50.08, partial eta-squared .47, p < .001) and current interference by previous interference (F(1,53)=24.38, partial eta-squared .32, p < .001). None can be assigned to 1594 versus 1595 from identical original descriptions/locators. Printed candidates are retained without selecting a row target. The Method reports 54 consenting participants (30 female), a recruitment/contributor count. Results specify correct trials for RT and preceding-correct trials for previous-demand analyses. No separate explicit critical-model analytic participant count or mutually exclusive final groups is stated. No N is inferred from degrees of freedom or from 60 within-person trials; no N sum or effect-size conversion was made. Recruitment 54 is a candidate only for parent field-scope review, not an extracted analytic N.
